findings.title: Cleartext Traffic Allowed for 5 Staging/Target Domains
findings.description: Network Security Config permits insecure HTTP traffic to: stgaws.alfacart.com, s1stgaws.alfacart.com, stgpapa.alfadigital.id, maps.google.com, microsite-sandbox.web.narindo.id. MITM attackers on the same network can intercept sensitive credentials and tokens.

findings.title: Exported Third-Party Debug Activity (com.moengage.sdk.debugger.MoEDebuggerActivity)
findings.description: Found exported debug activities left in production binary: com.moengage.sdk.debugger.MoEDebuggerActivity. Activities like MoEngage MoEDebuggerActivity or Flipper/Chucker leak internal diagnostic logs and allow unauthorized intent dispatching.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Access to Sensitive Activities (com.alfamart.alfagift.screen.eservice.shoppingassistant.ShoppingAssistantActivity, com.alfamart.alfagift.screen.wallet.otp.OtpWalletActivity)
findings.description: Sensitive payment/wallet/auth activities are exported without permission protection: com.alfamart.alfagift.screen.eservice.shoppingassistant.ShoppingAssistantActivity, com.alfamart.alfagift.screen.wallet.otp.OtpWalletActivity, com.alfamart.alfagift.screen.wallet.aladin.AladinWebViewActivity, com.alfamart.alfagift.screen.wallet.linked.LinkedWalletActivity. Malicious third-party apps can trigger these screens directly to bypass login or KYC verification.

findings.title: Weak Cryptography: Insecure Cipher (Blowfish)
findings.description: Detected legacy or insecure cryptographic implementations: Blowfish. Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode preserves plaintext patterns, and Blowfish/DES are considered broken for modern high-assurance mobile applications.

findings.title: 3 Hardcoded Secrets / Tokens Detected
findings.description: Detected potential Google/Firebase API keys, AWS credentials, or authentication tokens hardcoded in application binary or asset bundles.

findings.title: High Number of Dangerous Permissions (14)
findings.description: Requesting numerous high-privilege Android runtime permissions increases attack surface and may trigger Google Play reviews.
